title: 第二十一章 蛟珠淬灵武徒二重风声至第二十二章 竹林喋血双二重武道死战
lines: 第二十一章蛟珠淬灵，武徒二重风声至
晚风散尽，月华铺洒侯府青石长道。
沈砚缓步离开沁柳院，身后院内紧绷的杀气、林立的刀锋、三房众人的忌惮与恨意，尽数被夜色隔绝。一路走来，沿途往来巡逻的三房护卫、打杂杂役，远远望见那道青衫身影，无不低头侧身，快步避让，不敢有半分直视。
不过一夜之间，沈砚早已不是任人拿捏欺凌的旁支少年。
新晋武徒，稳压三房所有淬体护卫，当众逼柳氏低头妥协，洗脱一身污名，这份实力，足以让侯府中下所有人敬畏臣服。
往日旁人路过西落院，皆是鄙夷漠视，甚至故意踩踏院外花草、出言讥讽，如今整条院落廊道，静谧无声，无人敢靠近半步。
片刻功夫，沈砚驻足西落院门前。
院门铁链紧锁，封条斑驳干枯，是三日前柳氏下令查封院落时所贴，封条之上，印着三房专属朱砂印鉴，隔绝内外，断了他最后的落脚之地。院墙边花木枯萎，石阶落满厚尘，尽显荒凉破败。
这里是他入侯府以来，唯一安稳栖身之地。自幼无父无母，无宗族庇护，数年光阴，他守着这座偏僻小院，省吃俭用积攒丹药，日夜苦修打磨肉身，熬过无数被欺凌、被克扣资源的苦寒日子。
三房欺压他，牵连院内下人，不过是为了拿捏他软肋，肆意践踏他仅剩的安稳。
沈砚抬手，指尖一缕莹白灵力流转，轻描淡写触碰紧锁铁链。
咔嚓。
坚硬生铁锁链应声断裂，门口封条无风自落，飘落在地碎裂开来。
他抬手推开院门，木门吱呀作响，院内晚风裹挟草木尘土扑面而来，屋内桌椅布满灰尘，器皿散落一地，皆是当日三房护卫查封院落时，肆意打砸留下的狼藉。
当初服侍他的小厮阿禾，老实本分，年仅十五，身世和沈砚一般孤苦，无依无靠，唯有依附西落院谋生。只因平日里尽心伺候沈砚，便被三房护卫当众杖责二十，逐出侯府，流落青阳城街头。
少年心性，最懂底层孤苦之难。
沈砚眸底掠过一丝冷意，柳氏今夜口头妥协，答应召回阿禾、致歉赔偿，可此人城府极深，擅长阳奉阴违，大概率会刻意拖延，甚至暗中加害阿禾，杜绝后患。
不能被动等候对方施舍履约，需主动出手，接回阿禾。
心念既定，沈砚不再耽搁，转身欲动身出城，余光却瞥见廊道尽头，一道瘦小身影快步跑来，衣衫破旧，后背带着未消的杖伤淤青，额头渗汗，步履匆忙，正是被逐出府的小厮阿禾。
“公子！”
阿禾看见院门前青衫人影，眼眶瞬间泛红，不顾后背伤口牵扯疼痛，快步跪倒石阶之下，声音哽咽，“奴才还以为，再也见不到公子了！听闻公子孤身回府，对峙三房，奴才拼着被护卫驱赶，也要回来等候公子！”
少年小厮满脸风尘，掌心磨出厚茧，后背杖伤渗血，这几日流落城外，三餐无着，受尽街边地痞欺凌，却始终记挂沈砚安危，一心想要回府相伴。
沈砚眼底戾气散去几分，上前抬手，灵力轻托，扶起跪地的阿禾。温润灵力悄然渡入阿禾体内，舒缓后背伤口肿痛，修复受损皮肉经脉。
“伤可还好？这几日在外，可有人刻意为难你？”沈砚语气平和，褪去对外人的清冷凌厉，多了几分温和。
阿禾身子一怔，清晰感知到暖流抚平伤口痛感，抬头看向沈砚，才猛然发觉，自家公子周身气质全然蜕变，温润厚重，自带慑人气场，早已和往日隐忍模样截然不同。
“公子……您变强了。”阿禾脱口而出，眼底满是笃定。
以往公子面对三房护卫，只能隐忍避让，如今却能护住自身，护住他这个下人。
“往后，无人再敢欺你。”沈砚淡淡开口，语气笃定，“三房杖责驱逐之仇，我会一一记下，来日，必让他们加倍赔付。今夜起，安心留在西落院，收拾院落，安心度日即可。”
得到沈砚应允，阿禾重重点头，眼底阴霾散尽，重焕光亮，躬身领命，转身便拿起院内扫帚抹布，默默打扫满院狼藉。
沈砚放心颔首，转身走入院内最深处的僻静密室。
这间密室是他早年耗费半月亲手开凿，地处地底，密闭隔音，隔绝外人探查神识，灵气聚拢不散，是西落院内唯一一处安全修行之地。往日修为低微，他在此躲避欺凌、静心苦修，如今成就武徒，此地依旧是炼化至宝、精进修为的绝佳场所。
关上密室石门，隔绝外界所有声响，密室之内一片静谧，只剩均匀呼吸之声。
沈砚盘膝坐于青石蒲团之上，摒除心中杂念，抬手取出贴身藏匿的碧鳞蛟珠。
月华微光透过石缝洒落，蛟珠通体碧绿剔透，流光内蕴，表层流转淡淡水木灵光，温润灵气顺着掌心源源不断侵入肌理，远比侯府上品淬体丹药精纯数十倍。
此珠孕育数十年，吸纳玄水灵泉精华，承载碧鳞蛟半生修为，更是半步武徒妖兽凝练的本命兽核，价值远超青阳城市面所有修行宝物。
此前他于灵泉之内稳固武徒一重，只是堪堪入门，气海容积狭小，灵力凝练度不足，战力尚有上限。若是直接对战府内老牌武徒执事，依旧稍有劣势。

Chapter 21: The dragon bead is quenching the spirit, and rumors of the second level of martial arts are coming
The evening wind has dispersed, and the moonlight spreads over the long bluestone road of the Hou Mansion.
Shen Yan slowly left Qinliu Courtyard. The tense murderous aura in the courtyard behind him, the numerous blades, and the fear and hatred of everyone in the three rooms were all cut off by the night. Along the way, the guards and handymen patrolling the three rooms along the way saw the blue-shirted figure in the distance. They all lowered their heads and turned sideways, quickly stepping aside and not daring to look directly at him.
But overnight, Shen Yan was no longer a sideline boy who could be manipulated and bullied.
The newly promoted martial arts disciple suppressed all the body-tempering guards in the third room, forced Mrs. Liu to bow her head and compromise in public, and cleared away her stigma. This strength was enough to make everyone in the Hou Mansion awe and surrender.
In the past, when people passed by Xiluo Courtyard, they would treat it with contempt and indifference, and even deliberately trample on the flowers and plants outside the courtyard and make sarcastic remarks. Now, the entire courtyard corridor is silent, and no one dares to come even half a step closer.
After a while, Shen Yan stopped in front of the gate of Xiluoyuan.
The courtyard door is tightly locked with iron chains, and the seal is mottled and dry. It was affixed three days ago when Mrs. Liu ordered the courtyard to be sealed off. On the seal, there is the exclusive cinnabar seal of Sanfang, isolating the inside and outside, and cutting off his final place to stay. The flowers and trees along the courtyard walls are withered, and the stone steps are covered with thick dust, making it appear desolate and dilapidated.
This is the only stable place he has lived in since he entered the Marquis Mansion. He had no father or mother since he was a child, and had no clan to protect him. For several years, he guarded this remote courtyard, saved money and saved up elixirs, practiced hard day and night to polish his body, and survived countless bitter and cold days of being bullied and having his resources deprived of him.
The third room oppressed him and implicated the servants in the courtyard, just to take advantage of his weakness and trample on his remaining stability.
Shen Yan raised his hand, a wisp of white spiritual energy flowing through his fingertips, and lightly touched the locked iron chain.
Click.
The hard pig iron chain broke with a sound, and the door seal fell without any wind, falling to the ground and shattering.
He raised his hand and pushed open the courtyard door. The wooden door creaked. The evening breeze in the courtyard carried the dust of vegetation and blew towards his face. The tables and chairs in the house were covered with dust, and utensils were scattered all over the floor. They were all messes left behind by the three-room guards who smashed and smashed the courtyard when they sealed it.
The young boy who served him, Ah He, was an honest man who was only fifteen years old. Like Shen Yan, he was lonely and had no one to rely on, so he had to rely on Xiluoyuan to make a living. Just because he devoted himself to serving Shen Yan on weekdays, he was beaten twenty times by the guards of the third room in public, expelled from the Marquis Mansion, and lived on the streets of Qingyang City.
The young mind understands best the hardship of loneliness at the bottom.
A coldness flashed across Shen Yan's eyes. Mrs. Liu made a verbal compromise tonight and promised to recall Ah He and apologize and compensate. However, this person is very deep in the city and is good at subverting the situation. There is a high probability that he will deliberately delay or even harm Ah He secretly to avoid future troubles.
You can't passively wait for the other party to give charity and fulfill the contract. You need to take the initiative to take Ah He back.
With his mind set, Shen Yan stopped delaying and turned around to leave the city. Out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of a thin figure running towards the end of the corridor. His clothes were shabby, his back was bruised from the stick wound, sweat was dripping from his forehead, and he was walking in a hurry. He was none other than Ah He, the young man who had been expelled from the mansion.
"Master!"
Ah He saw the figure in green shirt in front of the courtyard, his eyes instantly turned red. Regardless of the pain in the wound on his back, he quickly knelt down under the stone steps, his voice choked with sobs, "I thought I would never see the young master again! I heard that the young master returned to the house alone and confronted the third room. I tried my best to be driven away by the guards, but I also want to come back and wait for the young master!"
The young boy's face was dusty, his palms were calloused, and his back was bleeding from the stick wound. He had been living outside the city for the past few days, without food, and was bullied by the gangsters on the street. However, he always cared about Shen Yan's safety and wanted to return home to be with him.
The fierceness in Shen Yan's eyes dissipated a little, and he stepped forward and raised his hand, using his spiritual power to lift up Ahe who was kneeling on the ground. The warm spiritual power quietly enters Ahe's body, soothes the swelling and pain of the wound on the back, and repairs the damaged skin and meridians.
"Is the injury okay? Has anyone deliberately made things difficult for you outside these days?" Shen Yan's tone was calm, losing his coldness and harshness towards outsiders and becoming a bit gentler.
Ah He was startled. He clearly felt the warm current soothing the pain of the wound. He raised his head to look at Shen Yan, and suddenly realized that his young master's temperament had completely changed. He was warm and thick, with an intimidating aura. He was completely different from the forbearing appearance of the past.
"Sir... you have become stronger." Ah He blurted out, his eyes full of determination.
In the past, the young master could only hide and avoid the guards of the third room, but now he can protect himself and his servant.
"From now on, no one will dare to bully you again." Shen Yan said calmly, with a firm tone, "I will write down the revenge of the three-fang rod for expulsion one by one, and I will make them pay double the compensation in the future. From tonight on, just stay in Xiluo Courtyard with peace of mind, tidy up the courtyard, and live with peace of mind."
After receiving Shen Yan's consent, Ah He nodded heavily, the gloom in his eyes dissipated and became bright again. He bowed to accept the order, turned around, picked up the broom and rag in the courtyard, and silently cleaned up the mess in the courtyard.
Shen Yan nodded in relief, turned around and walked into the secluded secret room at the deepest part of the courtyard.
He spent half a month digging this secret room with his own hands in his early years. It is located underground and is airtight and soundproof to prevent outsiders from exploring his spiritual consciousness. The spiritual energy gathers and never disperses. It is the only safe place to practice in Xiluo Courtyard. In the past, when his cultivation was low, he avoided bullying and practiced hard here. Now he has become a martial arts disciple. This place is still an excellent place for refining treasures and improving his cultivation.
After closing the stone door of the secret room, all sounds from the outside world were blocked. There was silence in the secret room, except for the sound of even breathing.
Shen Yan sat cross-legged on the bluestone futon, put aside the distracting thoughts in his mind, and raised his hand to take out the jade-scaled dragon bead hidden close to his body.
The glimmer of moonlight shines through the cracks in the stone, and the dragon bead is completely green and translucent, with a stream of light inside. A light fresh water wood spiritual light flows on the surface, and the warm spiritual energy continuously penetrates into the texture along the palm, which is dozens of times purer than the top-grade body tempering elixir of the Hou Mansion.
This bead has been gestated for decades, absorbing the essence of the Xuanshui spiritual spring, carrying the half-life cultivation of the jade-scaled dragon. It is also the condensed natal beast core of the half-step warrior demon beast. Its value far exceeds all the cultivation treasures in Qingyang City.
Previously, he had stabilized the first level of martial arts in Lingquan, but he was just a beginner.
